Coppermouths are fierce and aggressive, even when alone, relying on their venom and ability to manipulate bioelectric impulses. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 23 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 [Giant Coppermouth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3283) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 152 **Perception** +18; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), greater electrolocation 20 feet, [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 30 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +17, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +14, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +15 **Str** +3 **Dex** +6 **Con** +4 **Int** -4 **Wis** +4 **Cha** -2 **Deep Breath** The giant coppermouth can [hold its breath](/Rules.aspx?ID=2436) for 1 hour.
**Greater Electrolocation** A giant coppermouth can sense minute electrical charges in living creatures, which it can use as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) at a range of 20 feet. This distance increases to 100 feet against any creature that has used an [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) effect within the last minute. --- **AC** 25 **Fort** +15 **Ref** +18 **Will** +12 **HP** 115 **Immunities** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) --- **Speed** 30 feet, climb 20 feet, swim 20 feet **Melee** fangs +18 ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)), **Damage** 2d8+6 piercing plus 1d4 electricity and coppermouth venom **Coppermouth Venom** ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and 1d6 electricity (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d6 poison and 1d6 electricity and [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d6 poison and 2d6 electricity and clumsy 2 **Quickening Jolt** ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56)) The coppermouth manipulates its own nervous system by increasing its reaction time, Striding and making two Strikes against different targets during the movement. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made both attacks. **Venomous Spit** ([Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) The coppermouth unleashes a stream of electrified venom in a 30-foot line. The venom deals 8d6 electricity damage (DC 22 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save) and creatures that take damage from the venom are immediately exposed to coppermouth venom. The copper mouth can't use Venomous Spit again for 1d4 rounds.
name: Giant Coppermouth
